commits.subject: J6: a side road with a mouth corner on the main road and above it is blended onto it (J2), not just its mouth row lowered (no step to the patch's surface)
J6: each corner takes the chain that bends least (as the side lint measures it, the strips' edges on at both ends), J5's sides first within a degree
J6: the non-star junction mesh gets points along the through road's carriageway edges – no junction surface above the main road (BF north / middle had 6 – 9 cm)

Built: the sides of a road are as smooth as the road, J6 (4.8.8 Rule) – no V at Letzanaweg, no side road above the main road, outlines need only be simple polygons, each corner the chain that bends least (5.64)

Merge J6: the verge's V-notch gone (square verges, smoothed outer edges), side roads never above the main road (above_main 0 everywhere), constrained Delaunay surfaces for outlines that are not star-shaped; packages in j6-build, not installed (4.8.8 Rule, 5.65)
J7 (4.8.8 Rule): paths along a road drawn as a band of its side, not junction arms; corners cut short turn round (BF path view); cluster corners between arms of different members
J7: side paths ridden at the height of the band drawn for them (the road's beside them, kerb, fall), ends meeting the junction surfaces; paths more than 0.5 m above or below the road stay their own

Built: a smaller browser module – Bevy's features pruned to what the browser uses, wasm-opt on every release build: the preview's WebGL 2 module 47.4 -> 43.4 MB, make web's 82.8 -> 63.7 MB; test routes on the iPhone profile 244 -> 213 MB peak (spec 10G, 5.65)
Merge origin/main (J6) into the browser module size branch; spec row renumbered 5.66

Merge a smaller browser module: explicit minimal Bevy features, no GL backend in the WebGPU build, wasm-opt on every release build; Loop/Hills 244 → 213 MB, Liechtenstein 434 → 414 MB on an iPhone 15 profile (10G, 5.66)

Built: the sides of a road are as smooth as the road, J7 (4.8.8 Rule) – paths along a road drawn as a band of its side, corners cut short turning round, cluster corners rounded; packages in data/j7-build (5.66)

Merge J7: paths along a road drawn as a band of its side (no own junction mouths), rounded cluster corners, round island noses; side.corner −21 to −32 %; packages in j7-build, not installed (4.8.8 Rule, 5.67)
J8 (4.8.8 Rule): a junction's arm runs on past a plain way split that squeezed it, mouths out for their corners' radius along the real edge lines; JNCT layout 4
Browser app with WebAssembly SIMD in both builds, a too-old message without it (Phase 10 Q10 (a))
J8: side-classify counts a junction with run-on way splits as one junction; J8 comparison views
J8: the corners' deficits without building their chains (the same patches, faster)
J8: mouths move out for their corners only on arms at most 6 % steep (Tenerife's road kinks +7 % -> +3.8 %); kink_diff example
The VR headset loads the browser app from the GitHub Pages preview, VR test builds under /xr/ (Phase 14 Q6 (a))
The browser's sensor bridge is built before the first headset runs, so the KICKR drives the headset ride (Phase 14 Q7 (b))
WebXR with the floor as reference (local-floor), the saddle at the profile's saddle height (Phase 14 Q8 (a))
A local sensor bridge first: the desktop app relays the trainer to a browser session on the same network, paired with a code, no account (10D.2; backend relay with Phase 5)

J8: a junction's patch alone keeps J7's mouths (clusters and run-on splits decided as before, no junction loses its surface); where the mouths out for the corners cannot be made, as before; surface_list example
Local sensor bridge core: pairing code, a certificate both sides derive from it, messages, relay logic and the desktop's WebTransport endpoint (14 Phase 10, 10D.2)
Share with a browser / Use a trainer from another device: the desktop's trainer drives a browser ride on the same network, SIM / ERG back (14 Phase 10, 10D.2)
Built: the browser app with WebAssembly SIMD in both builds, the start page says a browser without it is too old (Phase 10 Q10 (a))
Built: the browser app with WebAssembly SIMD, the iPhones' module 43.5 → 40.9 MiB, a too-old message without SIMD (Phase 10 Q10 (a), 5.73)

Potholes and cracks varied: own outlines, sizes, depths, clusters, filled holes; crack kinds (branched, wheel-track, edge, block, sealed); every road its own damage; the ride feels the new shapes (4.6 Road damage, Variety, 5.68)
Road damage shots: midday, low and close, configurable scenes
LOD distances: props 60 m, the unicorn 40 m, workshop pieces never, in the game and the studio (16H Q24 (a))
Road damage shots: views looking down beside the rider
The local sensor bridge is built: spec 10D.2 *Built (local bridge)* with the transport choice and the support matrix, measured on marge; Phase 10 Q11 (iOS before 26.4) open (v5.73)
Road damage shots: a view along the road from in front
Level-of-detail distances in one table: props 60 m, the unicorn 40 m, workshop pieces never, in the game and the studio (16H Q24 (a), v5.74)
Sensor bridge: rustfmt, and the loopback run's numbers in 10D.2
J8: mouths moved out and arms run on past a split only where the junction's sides bend no more than before (the Black Forest path view keeps its round nose)

Merge varied potholes and cracks: a damage seed per road, noise-warped hole outlines, clusters, filled patches, transverse / block / alligator / sealed cracks, damage that stays visible on wet roads, the ride feel following the drawn outlines (4.6 Road damage, 5.74)
Merge level-of-detail distances in one table: props 60 m, the unicorn 40 m, workshop pieces never, in the game and the studio (16H Q24 (a), 5.75)

Merge the local sensor bridge: the desktop app shares its trainer with one browser on the same network over WebTransport, paired with a code that carries the address and derives the certificate; no account (10D.2, 5.76)
Merge the WebXR spike (14I W0 + W1) onto main

WebXR ready for the first headset run: published at /xr/, local-floor with the eyes at the real head over the profile's saddle height, the sensor bridge paired on the XR page, the run's numbers back to the desktop (14I W0 + W1, Q6 (a), Q7 (b), Q8 (a); spec 5.77)
The eye-point test allows the low time-trial position (14I Q8)
WebXR: switch cameras before the shadow cascades are built (the chase camera's return after a session panicked in bevy_pbr), the eyes reported in the views' order (14I W1)
WebXR: the own head hidden during the session (the eyes saw the helmet straps and the face from inside; 14I W1)
10G: WebAssembly SIMD and WebKit RSS re-measured, 3 alternating rides each – Loop unchanged, Liechtenstein median +65 / +70 MB within overlapping runs; fps rerun noisy (Phase 10 Q10 (a))

Merge WebXR ready for the first headset run: the 18 November spike brought up to date, the XR build under /xr/ on the preview, local-floor eye height from the saddle, pairing with the desktop's bridge on the XR page, the report beacon over the bridge (14I W0/W1, Q6/Q7/Q8; 5.77)

Built: the sides of a road are as smooth as the road, J8 (4.8.8 Rule) – arms run on past plain way splits, mouths out for their corners; side.corner -5 to -9 %, no junction loses its surface; packages in data/j8-build, not installed (5.68)
Merge J8: junction arms run on past plain way splits, mouths lie out for their corners on gentle arms, bend guards; side.corner −5 to −9 %; packages in j8-build, not installed (4.8.8 Rule, 5.78)
WebXR rides with the bike computer on the bars, the Touch controllers and a Quest 1 quality level: 14I W2 and W3 built (spec 5.79)

Merge WebXR W2 + W3: the bike computer on the bars, no flat HUD in XR (menu as a world panel), the Quest controllers, the quest1 level with layer render scale and foveation, a frame-time readout and left-eye pictures in the beacon (14I, 5.79)
Merge main (WebXR W0–W3) into the SIMD branch: the XR module built with SIMD too, /xr/ refused without it; spec row renumbered to 5.80 (Phase 10 Q10 (a))
Merge the browser app with WebAssembly SIMD in all builds (WebGPU, WebGL 2, WebXR), a too-old message where SIMD is missing, and the site guard against non-SIMD builds (Phase 10 Q10 (a), 5.80)
